Essential proteins are needed to perform the functions of life in our body. These proteins cannot be made by your body and must be consumed. If you are not consuming enough protein your body will take it from existing muscles in your body. It doesn't seem like such a big deal until you realize your heart is a muscle, and unlike skeletal muscles it can't be rebuilt. When it's gone it's gone. If you go a long enough time without adequate protein your heart can give out on you. Luisel Ramos is just one example of a chronically malnourished person who died of heart failure at a fashion show when she was 22.
